{"question": "患者六年前因什么工作习惯导致什么疾病，接受了什么治疗，效果如何？ 对应门诊收费发票的完整编号是什么？", "context": [{"id": "MEM-1", "content": "用户三十五岁，六年前（约2020年9月）因长期伏案工作导致颈椎病，出现脖子僵硬症状", "metadata": {"evaluation": "synthetic-component-v2", "type": "consultation_event", "timestamp": "2026-09-08T09:59:58.257699+00:00", "source_session_id": "session-1", "user_id": "M11-07", "agent_id": "component-v2", "attributed_to": "user"}}, {"id": "MEM-2", "content": "用户因颈椎病接受了医生建议的理疗治疗，持续两个月后症状好转", "metadata": {"evaluation": "synthetic-component-v2", "type": "consultation_event", "timestamp": "2026-09-08T09:59:58.257699+00:00", "source_session_id": "session-1", "user_id": "M11-07", "agent_id": "component-v2", "attributed_to": "user"}}, {"id": "MEM-3", "content": "用户治疗后注意保持正确姿势，颈椎病症状未再复发", "metadata": {"evaluation": "synthetic-component-v2", "type": "consultation_event", "timestamp": "2026-09-08T09:59:58.257699+00:00", "source_session_id": "session-1", "user_id": "M11-07", "agent_id": "component-v2", "attributed_to": "user"}}, {"id": "MEM-4", "content": "用户两年前（约2024年9月）因加班多导致颈椎病复发，脖子再次疼痛。这次没有做理疗，而是自行购买按摩仪，每天使用十分钟，坚持三个月后症状消失。", "metadata": {"evaluation": "synthetic-component-v2", "type": "consultation_event", "timestamp": "2026-09-08T10:00:28.027387+00:00", "source_session_id": "session-2", "user_id": "M11-07", "agent_id": "component-v2", "attributed_to": "user"}}]}
